paper.title_en: Echoes and light rings of regular black holes and their singular counterparts
paper.abstract_en: Recent work [Phys. Rev. D 111, 104040] showed that the Bardeen and Hayward solutions arise as fine-tuned regular members of broader families that also contain singular black holes. We study massless scalar and auxiliary Maxwell perturbations of these solutions using time-domain evolution and a sixth-order WKB approximation. For part of the singular branch, the time-domain profiles exhibit late-time echoes and the effective potentials develop a double-barrier structure. We also examine null geodesics of the background metric. The same singular branch can have two exterior maxima of the null effective potential separated by a minimum, whereas the type-I regular black holes have a single exterior maximum. The Bardeen and Hayward families display the same qualitative behavior.
